pathStartswith.mysql: SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING($field, LOCATE('://', $field) + 3), LOCATE('/', SUBSTRING($field, LOCATE('://', $field) + 3)), LOCATE('?', SUBSTRING($field, LOCATE('://', $field) + 3)) - LOCATE('/', SUBSTRING($field, LOCATE('://', $field) + 3))) LIKE CONCAT(?, '%')
pathStartswith.sqlserver: SUBSTRING($field, CHARINDEX('/', $field, CHARINDEX('://', $field) + 3), CHARINDEX('?', $field) - CHARINDEX('/', $field, CHARINDEX('://', $field) + 3)) LIKE ? + '%'

isFqdn.mysql: CASE WHEN LOCATE('.', $field) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = ?
isFqdn.postgres: CASE WHEN POSITION('.' IN $field) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END = $1
isFqdn.sqlite: CASE WHEN INSTR($field, '.') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = ?
isFqdn.sqlserver: CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('.', $field) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = ?

distanceWithin.sqlite:
111.111 * DEGREES(ACOS(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1,
                COS(RADIANS(90 - json_extract($field, '$.lat'))) *
                COS(RADIANS(90 - ?)) *
                COS(RADIANS(json_extract($field, '$.lng') - ?)) +
                SIN(RADIANS(90 - json_extract($field, '$.lat'))) *
                SIN(RADIANS(90 - ?))
            )))) <= ?

queries.description: Get all posts, optionally filtered by author.
queries.name: posts
